name: aws-workshop-studio
description: hi-aws-skills fork of workshop-scaffold, insight-first: generate a hands-on AWS workshop from a topic, scenarios, and target customer in the quick-* VitePress format — with the architecture rationale (why this architecture, what each service contributes, what changes once adopted) rendered on the overview page and architecture diagrams drawn with aws-diagram-design — plus standalone AWS fact-checking (aws-fact-check) and level×role persona review (persona-review). Commands: /new-workshop, /workshop-check, /workshop-walkthrough; agent: participant-walker. Korean triggers: 워크샵 만들어줘, 핸즈온 워크샵 스캐폴드, 페르소나 평가, 사실 확인.
